create_wigner_data_module: create a WignerDataModule with precomputed coefficients and U blocks for a given maximum angular momentum lmax
precompute_wigner_coefficients: precompute Wigner D matrix coefficients for angular momentum levels lmin through lmax using symmetry to halve computation
wigner_d_matrix_real: compute Wigner D matrices from real and imaginary parts of Ra and Rb using precomputed coefficients
wigner_d_pair_to_real: transform complex Wigner D matrices represented as real-pair tensors into real basis using U transformation blocks
quaternion_to_ra_rb_real: decompose a quaternion tensor into real and imaginary parts of Ra and Rb for Wigner D computation
